selection_rule: Evaluate in preference order; choose using measured clean task-disjoint validation and deployment outcomes, not brand rank.

requires_dist: hf-xet<2.0.0,>=1.5.2; platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "amd64" or platform_machine == "AMD64" or platform_machine == "arm64" or platform_machine == "aarch64"

qwen_text_route.kernel_policy: Explicitly record PyTorch reference versus separately pinned FLA/causal-conv1d; no silent performance assumption.

common_hf_bf16_lora.peft_torchao_policy: torchao absent; peft0.21.0 rejects installed torchao<0.16.0. Any optional torchao route needs its own torch ABI matrix.
common_hf_bf16_lora.wheel_platform_policy: Every staged wheel tag must intersect packaging.tags.sys_tags() for the admitted Linux x86_64 runtime. Exact Python major.minor must be recorded in environment lock; official hash alone does not prove ABI compatibility.

verification_notes: No weight shard was downloaded or executed.
Each downloaded non-LFS file SHA256 is backed by a recomputed upstream Git blob SHA1.
Each weight shard SHA256 is the upstream LFS oid from the API at the pinned revision.
Model index total_size is descriptive upstream metadata, not authority over shard headers or memory estimates.
Per-candidate source metadata may contain padded embedding rows; tokenizer length equality is not required.

Granite upstream model.safetensors.index.json total_size=16761102336 is inconsistent with 8791592960 BF16 parameters and 17583228032 total shard-file bytes; preserve index verbatim and validate actual safe tensor headers independently.
No official template contains assistant generation-mask blocks; assistant-only labels require an independently tested renderer/mask.
Seed official chat template rejects a system role; use a recorded user-only prompt format.
